name: perspective_view_validate

inputBounds.documentForm: the parsed View document as a JSON object; the server measures the byte ceiling on its compact re-serialization (separators (",", ":"), ensure_ascii=false), so the measurement does not depend on how the client spaced its request
inputBounds.documentSerialization: compact JSON, separators (",", ":"), ensure_ascii=false, NaN and Infinity refused
inputBounds.requiredStructure: a JSON object with a 'root' object whose 'type' is a string
inputBounds.unknownComponentTypes: accepted: this validator checks structure and budget, never the component inventory of a particular Ignition patch
inputBounds.checkOrder: structure, then depth, then bytes, so no document reaches the serializer deep enough to exhaust its recursion

offlineValidationIsNotAcceptance: a passing validation does not promise that an Ignition import accepts the document (D15)
